metadata.description: Shadow Mirror — referential introspection for test planning and coverage mapping.

plugins.name: shadow-mirror
plugins.description: Run the seven-phase scientific-validation loop (SM-0..SM-6) to prove correctness, plan tests, and map the semantic coverage that line coverage hides. Ships a skill, a /shadow-mirror command, a validation subagent, the `sm` engine (map/plan/verify/delta), and an MCP server.
